newsitem.title: USA: Cold, wet weather hinders Texas fieldwork.
newsitem.headline: Cold, wet weather hinders Texas fieldwork.

text.p: Cold, wet weather hindered fieldwork in Texas during the week ended Sunday, the weekly state crop report said.
"A combination of the Thanksgiving holiday and a reinforcement of cold, wet conditions brought about by another cold front kept producers idle," the report said.
Cotton harvest was slowed in the Plains, although the recent freezing temperatures should help harvesting activity in north central Texas.
Texas wheat was rated 72 percent of normal, versus 73 percent last week and 57 percent last year.
Sorghum harvested 98 percent vs 97 w/a, 100 y/a, 99 avg.
Cotton harvested 75 percent vs 69 w/a, 76 y/a, 74 avg.
Cotton rated 72 percent of normal vs 68 w/a, 57 y/a.
Pasture and range condition was rated 38 percent good to excellent, versus 32 percent at that level last week.
